harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired and deployed the UDP meter collector on node1. It now validates nonnegative decimal sequence/readings, appends valid unique records, persistently ignores duplicate meter/sequence pairs, logs malformed datagrams separately, and survives collector and node restarts. The original west,1,42 reading remains intact. Both nodes were rebooted sequentially and fully recovered without changing the installed RHEL release or kernel.
actions_performed: Replaced collector.py with a Python 3-compatible validated collector.
Created and enabled udp-meter-collector.service with automatic restart.
Opened UDP/9098 in runtime and permanent firewalld configuration.
Tested valid, duplicate, malformed, and post-malformed traffic from node2.
Verified durable deduplication and data retention across a collector restart.
Safely rebooted node2 and node1 one at a time and verified changed boot identities and recovery.
Completed a post-reboot end-to-end UDP test and exact CSV audit.

evidence.requirement: Collector running and reachable on UDP/9098
evidence.summary: Collector is enabled, active, listening on 0.0.0.0:9098, and firewalld permits the port.

evidence.requirement: Valid datagrams append; duplicates are ignored; malformed datagrams are recorded without stopping collection
evidence.summary: Direct node2 transmissions and node1 assertions prove valid appends, duplicate suppression, separate malformed logging, and continued collection after malformed traffic.

evidence.requirement: Previously recorded reading is preserved across collector restarts
evidence.summary: The original west,1,42 row was captured before repair, retained after the collector PID changed, and remained protected by persistent duplicate detection.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 before and after work/reboots.
Healthy baseline boot ID e625…6fe1, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID e913…ad95, recovered system/network, and successful post-reboot UDP delivery are proven.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and collector/data recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 6d37…1e09, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 5a41…f536, automatic collector/firewall recovery, retained data, and successful post-reboot ingestion are proven.
